```python
import pygame

width, height = 800, 600
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((width, height))
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

background_color = (30, 30, 50)

object_pos = [400, 300]  # Original object position
object_radius = 40

# Variables for head/viewpoint rotation (simulated with mouse)
yaw = 0  # Horizontal rotation in degrees
pitch = 0  # Vertical rotation in degrees

running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():

    transformed_x = object_pos[0] + yaw

```
